scoring.semantic_pass: Human review: answer must satisfy every case rubric item, contain no material factual error, address the exact request/context and use natural Russian. Any invented observation, unsafe action claim, wrong named entity/math result, or ignored negation fails. Review all answers, including those passing regex checks.
scoring.naturalness: 0: unusable or internal reasoning; 1: understandable but stilted/repetitive; 2: clear, natural, appropriately brief. Independent reviewer not available must be disclosed.
scoring.objective_checks: Regex checks are screening only, not semantic accuracy. Intent cases require exact JSON and never execute actions.
scoring.selection: Exact answer hashes bind human or explicitly AI-assisted rubric review. Screening regex is not semantic accuracy. Require complete calibration and heldout review, three warm samples and allocation evidence before profile recommendation; browser/voice/Windows gates remain separate.
